description: Get the account this key belongs to: how many changeable codes it has used and has left, its plans and when they renew, the plans on sale with yearly prices, the page where the person buys one (buy_at), and the folders in use. Call it before create_code when unsure there's room for another changeable code, after create_code fails for that reason, or to find folder names for list_codes. You can't buy plans: give the person the buy_at link. Wi-Fi, text, email, phone and SMS codes never use the allowance. Read only; works with any key.
name: get_account

buy_at.description: Where the person buys a plan (only while plans are on)

allowed.description: A number, or "unlimited ..." while plans are switched off

locked.description: Codes beyond the allowance after a plan lapsed: they work but can't be edited

folders.description: Folders in use, with how many codes each holds

ending.description: true when set to end instead of renewing

plans_switched_on.description: false while the site gives changeable codes away free and unlimited

title: Account and plans
